Since the pace of game rules were applied, we've already seen a drop in average game time from a record high during the 2014 season. The team with the longest average game time for a season within this 25-year period was the 2014 Boston Red Sox at 197 minutes. The team with the shortest average game time for a season was the 2003 Detroit Tigers at 159 minutes. There was a noticeable drop in the average length of games in the mid-2000s before beginning to rise again.
